module: Display (UI) layer of drift. Every frame, publishes on the "drift" UI stream the state of each tracked vehicle (permanent score, potential score, cached score, combo, remaining combo time, creep, angle, speed, performance factor, confirmed score presentation phase). Reacts to the score, crash, spinout, cascade zone, spot and tier hooks with flash messages (TopCenterAppsFlashMessage) and guihooks events, and shows/hides the drift UI apps (scoreboard, tasks, driftScores, flashMessage) depending on the gameplay_drift_general context. Loaded by general in the contexts inChallenge, inFreeroamChallenge, inFreeroamCruising and inSplitscreen.
notes: "drift" stream: { context, players = { ["<playerId>"] = {permanentScore, potentialScore, realtimePerformanceFactor, realtimeCachedScoreFloored, realtimeCombo, realtimeRemainingComboTime, realtimeCreep, realtimeAngle, realtimeAirSpeed, scorePhase, scorePhaseProgress, confirmedScore, confirmedScoreId} } }. The players keys are strings so that the stream is always serialized as an object.

Confirmed score presentation: phase machine hold (0.9 s) -> dwindle (0.6 s) -> linger (0.5 s) -> idle; total duration 2.0 s (getScorePresentationDuration). Durations are counted in real time (dtReal).
Flash messages are ignored in the inFreeroam context and if the message is empty; default duration 1.5 s (2 s for a spot failure).
realtimeAngle is only filled if |angle| < maxAngle, vehicle oversteering, above the min drift speed, not airborne and not in walking mode.

Emitted guihooks events: ScenarioRealtimeDisplay, ClearTasklist, TopCenterAppsFlashMessage, displayDriftScoreModifier, setDriftPersistentDriftScored, setDriftRealtimeFail (single table {reason, playerId}), stuntZoneScored ({type, score}).

Contexts -> apps: inChallenge = enableDriftMissionUI (driftMission game state, tasks app); inFreeroamChallenge = scoreboard if multiplayer otherwise driftScores, plus tasks; inFreeroamCruising = driftScores; inFreeroam = hide everything.
After onExtensionUnloaded, isUnloaded is true and onUpdate no longer publishes anything: the variable is never set back to false (the module is reloaded as a new instance).

getDriftDebugInfo.desc: Returns {default=false, canBeChanged=true} for the drift debug window.

getIsScorePresentationActive.desc: Indicates whether the confirmed score animation is in progress for this vehicle.

returns.desc: true if the phase is not idle.

getScorePresentationDuration.desc: Returns the total duration of the confirmed score presentation (hold + dwindle + linger). Used by driftSpots to wait for the end of the animation.

reset.desc: Empties the creep smoothers, the score presentations, the player data pool and the gameplay_ui genericMissionData data.

onUpdate.desc: Called every frame (except after unloading): debug window, drift stream publishing, wrong-way, out-of-bounds and remaining distance messages.

dtReal.desc: Real time delta in seconds, used for the animations.

onDriftCompletedScored.desc: Hook: starts the confirmed score presentation, displays "+points" and notifies the UI (setDriftPersistentDriftScored).

onDriftCrash.desc: Hook: shows the "crashed" failure in the UI and sets the smoother back to zero.

onDriftSpinout.desc: Hook: shows the "spinout" failure in the UI.

onDonutDriftScored.desc: Hook: flash message and stuntZoneScored event (donut type).

onNearPoleScored.desc: Hook: flash message and stuntZoneScored event (nearPole type).

onTightDriftScored.desc: Hook: flash message and stuntZoneScored event (tightDrift type).

onHitPoleScored.desc: Hook: flash message and stuntZoneScored event (hitPole type).

onDriftSpotCompleted.desc: Hook: end-of-spot flash message (new record or zone completed) with the score.

onDriftSpotFailed.desc: Hook: 2 s flash message with the failure reason text.

onDriftQuickMessageDisplay.desc: Hook: sends a quick message to the UI (displayDriftScoreModifier).

onDriftPlVehReset.desc: Hook: player's vehicle put back in place; resets the smoother, the score presentation and the real-time message.

onDriftCachedScoreReset.desc: Hook: the cached score was reset; clears the real-time message.

onDriftScoreWrappedUp.desc: Hook: the current score is force-validated (end of spot); starts the presentation and shows the bonus points.

onNewDriftTierReached.desc: Hook: shows the name of the new tier as a flash message.

onDriftContextChanged.desc: Hook: shows or hides the drift UI apps according to the new context.

onDriftDebugChanged.desc: Hook: when debug is disabled, hides the drift interface.

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook: removes the smoother and presentation of the destroyed vehicle.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook: immediately applies the UI matching the already active drift context.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook: hides the UI, empties the data and publishes an empty stream.

onSerialize.desc: Hook: saves driftDebugUILayout before Lua reload.
